upstream.scope: Two generic fixes PX-022's native reconnect evidence needed: the macOS renderer takes no user-initiated List/Table/Tree selection change while a session window carries the PX-022-G01 client-owned status (§18, §22.5), and srui-ssh-bridge ends, and its process exits, when its session daemon closes the connection while the SSH side stays open (§17, §20.1); no ConnectionManager, SessionController, protocol, registry, SDK, sessiond or srtop change

entries.feature: While LayoutRenderer.sessionWindowStatus is set, TableCollectionAdapter and OutlineCollectionAdapter answer selectionShouldChange(in:) false, so no click, arrow key or deselection changes a List, Table or Tree selection and nothing unreportable is kept in local selection memory; ControlFactory.allowsUserSelectionChange holds the gate, LayoutRenderer.setSessionWindowStatus(_:) sets it (closed while a status is shown, open when cleared or empty), every adapter a remount builds reads it; server-driven selection changes (promotion, its withdrawal, a promotion to an absent item, selection_mode none, reload and remount restores) always pass the gate because the adapters' suppressed changes bypass it and mode none clears with selectRowIndexes rather than deselectAll(nil); scrolling and tree disclosure are unaffected
entries.scope: PX-022-G02/client-macos Collections/TableCollectionAdapter.swift, Collections/OutlineCollectionAdapter.swift, RendererAppKit/ControlFactory.swift, RendererAppKit/LayoutRenderer.swift; RendererAppKitTests StaleWindowSelectionTests

entries.feature: srui-ssh-bridge ends as soon as the session daemon closes its connection, after flushing what the daemon sent, even while the SSH side stays open and idle (bridge_streams forwards the two directions separately instead of copy_bidirectional; SSH EOF still half-closes towards the daemon and keeps forwarding until it closes), and the binary leaves with std::process::exit rather than returning into a tokio runtime shutdown blocked on its stdin reader, so the SSH channel closes and an idle client sees its transport end
